# windowsddi_dns_srv_record_set (Resource)

Manages the SRV (service locator) records of one name in a zone, for example `_sip._tcp`.

The resource is authoritative for every SRV record of its name: records of that name and type that are not in the configuration are removed. Creating it fails when such records already exist, so existing records are adopted with `terraform import` instead; dynamic records (registered by clients or the DHCP server) can be replaced with `allow_overwrite_dynamic`.

Updates are not atomic: new values are added first, then TTLs are updated, then old values are removed, so the name never resolves empty. A failure midway leaves a mix of old and new values, which the next plan shows and corrects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "windowsddi_dns_srv_record_set" "sip" {
  zone_name = "lab.example.local"
  name      = "_sip._tcp"

  srv = [
    { priority = 10, weight = 60, port = 5060, target = "sip1.lab.example.local" },
    { priority = 10, weight = 40, port = 5060, target = "sip2.lab.example.local" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone, for example `www`, or `@` for the zone apex. Case is ignored. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `srv` (Attributes Set) Service targets, one SRV record each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--srv))
- `zone_name` (String) Zone holding the records, for example `lab.example.local`. Case and a trailing dot are ignored. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `allow_overwrite_dynamic` (Boolean) When `true`, creating the resource replaces existing dynamic records of the name (registered by clients or the DHCP server) instead of failing. Static records are never overwritten. Defaults to `false`. Terraform only, not read from the server.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds, applied to every record of the set (1 to 2147483647). When unset, the zone default is used on create and the server's value is reported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<zone_name>/<name>` in lowercase, the import ID.

<a id="nestedatt--srv"></a>
### Nested Schema for `srv`

Required:

- `port` (Number) TCP or UDP port of the service (0 to 65535).
- `priority` (Number) Priority (0 to 65535); lower values are tried first.
- `target` (String) Host name providing the service, for example `sip1.lab.example.local`. A trailing dot is optional and case is ignored.
- `weight` (Number) Relative weight (0 to 65535) among targets of the same priority.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID: <zone>/<name>, with @ for the zone apex.
terraform import windowsddi_dns_srv_record_set.sip lab.example.local/_sip._tcp
```
